title: Rahu: why you fall
too hard, too fast.
summary: What Rahu does when it sits in the part of your chart that holds love, fun and ideas: the gifts, the catches, and how to work with it.
film: Rahu: why you fall too hard, too fast
imageAlt: Maya with Rahu, the hungry head, beside her
basis: This guide is about where Rahu sits in your birth chart, which depends on your exact time of birth.
inside: Who Rahu is, and why he is never full
What he does to love, creativity and decisions
Five ways to work with him, and when he is loudest
intro: Some people cannot do ordinary in love. They fall quickly, think about one person all day, get bored by safe choices and are drawn to someone from a completely different world. In Vedic astrology this pattern has a name: Rahu sitting in the fifth house, the part of a chart that holds romance, play and ideas.
It is not a curse and it is not rare. It is an appetite. This guide explains where that appetite comes from, what it is good for, and what the tradition suggests doing with it.

sections.label: The planet
title: Rahu, the head
with no body.
paragraphs: Rahu is not a planet you can see. It is one of the two points where the Moon’s path crosses the Sun’s, the points where eclipses happen. The old story gives it a face: a head that drank a drop of the nectar of immortality and was cut from its body before it could swallow.

So Rahu wants, and can never be full. Wherever it sits in a chart it magnifies, exaggerates and craves. It is also read as the outsider: the foreign, the new, the unconventional, the thing your family did not expect.

sections.label: The room
title: The house of love,
fun and ideas.
paragraphs: A chart has twelve houses. The fifth is one of the happiest. Put a planet that is never satisfied in it, and every one of these themes gets louder.

items.name: Romance
items.text: Falling in love, flirting, dating and the first exciting phase of a relationship, as distinct from marriage itself.

items.name: Creativity
items.text: Whatever you make for the joy of it: writing, music, design, code, performance, cooking.

items.name: Intelligence
items.text: How your mind plays with ideas, and how you judge a risk before you take it.

items.name: Play
items.text: Games, sport, entertainment, and in the tradition children too, as the things we create and delight in.

items.name: Original ideas
items.text: A mind that will not sit still also will not accept the standard answer. People with this placement are read as inventive, and often early to new tools, new media and new ways of doing old things.

items.name: Magnetism
items.text: Rahu amplifies whatever it touches, and here it touches self-expression. There is often a talent for holding attention: on a stage, on a screen, or across a dinner table.

items.name: An open heart
items.text: The pull towards someone from another background, culture or generation can lead to relationships that widen your whole life.

items.name: Obsession
items.text: The appetite can fasten onto one person and turn a crush into a full-time occupation. The feeling is strong, but strength is not proof that the match is right.

items.name: Chasing the beginning
items.text: Rahu loves the start of things. The risk is leaving when the excitement fades, just as something real could begin.

items.name: Overthinking, then leaping
items.text: A clever mind can circle a decision for weeks and then jump in an afternoon. The tradition is especially wary here of bets on quick wins.

items.name: Never quite satisfied
items.text: Praise, attention and romance can feel like they are never enough. That is the head with no body speaking, not the truth about your life.

sections.label: What helps
title: Give the hunger
a job.
paragraphs: The classical advice is not to starve Rahu but to feed it something real. An appetite with a purpose becomes drive.

steps.name: Make things, regularly
steps.text: Write, build, paint, record, design. A steady creative practice is the single best outlet, because it uses the same restlessness that otherwise goes into fixation.

steps.name: Let love move at a human speed
steps.text: Give a new attraction three months before you decide what it is. If it is real it will still be there.

steps.name: Check the facts before you leap
steps.text: When you feel certain and rushed at the same moment, ask one grounded person what they see.

steps.name: Finish one thing
steps.text: Completing a project teaches this placement something that starting ten cannot.

steps.name: Keep your friendships warm
steps.text: The opposite point, Ketu, sits in your house of friends and can make you drift from groups. A few steady friends balance the intensity of romance.

sections.label: Timing
title: When he
is loudest.
paragraphs: A placement is always there, but it is not always switched on. It speaks loudest during Rahu’s own planetary period, which lasts eighteen years, and during the shorter Rahu sub-periods inside other planets’ periods. Many people recognise this guide most strongly in those years.

Rahu also moves through the sky, spending about a year and a half in each sign. On December 5, 2026 it enters Capricorn, which is the fifth house counted from a Virgo Moon. So people with a Virgo Moon get a temporary taste of this for the next year and a half, whatever their birth chart says.

faq.q: How do I know if my Rahu is in the fifth house?
faq.a: From your birth chart. The houses depend on your rising sign, which changes about every two hours, so you need your time of birth. Draw your chart on the home page and it is shown straight away.

faq.q: Is Rahu in the fifth house bad?
faq.a: No. The tradition treats Rahu as an amplifier: it gives ambition and originality along with restlessness. Whether it helps or hurts depends on what you feed it, and on the rest of your chart.

faq.q: Does this mean my relationships won’t last?
faq.a: No. It describes how you fall in love, not how your relationships end. Marriage is read from a different house, the seventh, and from the whole chart.

note: House meanings are those of the classical Parashari tradition, with whole-sign houses. Rahu’s position is calculated with the Lahiri ayanamsa.
